Hey Jess,

However, I’ve been living in Brisbane the past year after moving from Sydney and I’m desperately missing the costal lifestyle. Im currently looking for myself only ! I currently am a 2LIC at a cleaning company for millionaires mansions in hope island, so I would be more than happy to take control of cleaning responsibilities that we agree on. I’m also a student with 4 months left then I can be a high school pe teacher !!!! I love a healthy lifestyle that’s clean but also always down for an adventure and bits of fun ! Would be super happy to have a chat and give you more info that you need ! I would love to inspect whenever you’re free :)
